subtitulo: Five questions about flat delivery and borrowed jokes
introPt: A table teases, a traveller agrees cheerfully, and stays out of the old argument.
cenario: A long lunch, four people, and one visitor.

dialogo.es: はいはい、すごいすごい。よく言うわ。
dialogo.pt: Yeah yeah, amazing, amazing. Listen to you.
dialogo.tts: はいはい、すごいすごい。よく言うわ。

dialogo.es: 毎日ラーメンでしょ？正直に！
dialogo.tts: 毎日ラーメンでしょ？正直に！

dialogo.es: はい、犯人です。二杯食べました。
dialogo.pt: Guilty as charged. I had two bowls.
dialogo.tts: はい、犯人です。二杯食べました。

dialogo.es: いやあ、そこはノーコメントで！
dialogo.pt: Ha, on that one, no comment!
dialogo.tts: いやあ、そこはノーコメントで！

perguntas.pergunta: Sugoi sugoi, said in a completely level voice. What was meant?
perguntas.explica: The tsukkomi inverts by tone alone. The tell is the flatness, not the word.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone teases a friend in front of you and adds nante ne. What is that phrase doing?
opcoes: Closing the tease and marking it as affection
perguntas.explica: Nante ne, joudan joudan and uso uso all close the same move.

perguntas.pergunta: The table is telling jokes about a neighbouring country. What is your part?
opcoes: Tell one back — it shows you are comfortable
Laugh; do not collect it to retell
perguntas.explica: The genre is internal. Retold by a visitor it lands as a verdict, not as joining in.

perguntas.pergunta: They ask you to settle their Tokyo-versus-Osaka argument. Best move?
opcoes: Soko wa noo-komento de — then ask what they think
Say you have no opinion on anything
perguntas.explica: Being asked is hospitality, not a requirement to answer. Declining the comparison keeps you a guest.

perguntas.pergunta: Which joke reliably works in your mouth?
opcoes: One about yourself — your Japanese, your appetite, your daily ramen
One you heard at the next table
perguntas.explica: Self-deprecation is the only licence that comes with you on day one.
